Platform Engineer

Other role 1 Other role 2 Other role 3

Widget Co is hiring a Platform Engineer to help scale our infrastructure.

You'll work closely with our SRE team to build reliable, observable systems using Go, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Prometheus. We run a multi-region deployment across AWS and GCP, and you'll help us improve deployment velocity while reducing incident rates.

We're looking for someone with 4+ years of experience in backend or infrastructure engineering, strong Linux fundamentals, and a collaborative mindset. Experience with Python or Go is required; experience with service meshes is a plus.

Benefits include competitive salary, equity, health insurance, and unlimited PTO.
